title: Horse visited by ghost girl
excerpt: A security camera records what appears to be a little girl ghost visiting a horse.
content:
The internet is overloaded with AI slop and terrible videos of “paranormal” fakery. Once in a while, an interesting one comes along. I found this today on TikTok. It’s posted by a normal person who has horses. She has a few security cameras around. On September 2, 2026 she got this video of what has been interpreted as a “ghost girl” visiting a horse at 11pm on Monday night.

She noted additional details in a followup video including that the camera only records in 20 second clips when it detects motion. But was it triggered by the horse moving or a person around it? The other motion sensitive cameras in this area didn’t show anything. I have a similar trail/game type of camera and it does miss some images if the motion is too quick or too far away. The property is fairly isolated but it’s possible that a real child from a neighborhood came around. If so, that would also be weird. This looks to be a girl, 4 or 5 years old, in a nightgown or dress.

The followup video provides the scene in daylight so you can see the other objects in the video.

The best guess about what is going on here is that it is a real person, which is, itself, disturbing. But there are no other leads regarding who it could be.

Some people will say AI, but that doesn’t feel right for this person. While some hoaxes or normal explanations are SO obvious that they hit you over the head, others are not. It isn’t helpful to dismiss it as “hoax” without some justification. I have been working on a post about other “terrible skeptical explanations” that I will finish up in a bit. The point is, if you wish to give your opinion, it should be an educated one. In this case, and in others I’ve posted, I either have some clue about what happened (which is often wrong), or I just don’t know how or why something happened.

I don’t actually find typical ghost claims and research interesting anymore because the evidence is so poor or can’t be reproduced. So what good is it? At this point, it’s about belief. Unless we have some unexpected tech breakthough to explain space-time anomalies, we just aren’t getting anywhere with the big questions about paranormal claims.
